name: critique
description: Spawn an inline critique session that evaluates your work. Opens a live review box in the current chat. The critic uses the same model and config but fresh context. It judges the work, produces a structured report (Mark, Why, Suggestions), and the report is injected back into your chat for you to act on.

context.description: What to evaluate. Can be file paths, code snippets, descriptions of changes made, or any context the critic needs to review.

criteria.description: What to judge against. E.g., 'Check if the UI is responsive and accessible', 'Review code quality and error handling', 'Evaluate if the website looks professional'. Be specific about what matters.

focus.description: Optional focus area: 'visual' (UI/appearance), 'code' (code quality), 'functional' (does it work), 'security', or 'general'. Defaults to 'general'.
